applicabilityBasis.summary: Fiserv describes FIUSD as a proposed fully reserved USD-backed token for payments and settlement, redeemable at USD 1. The current product materials do not identify a finalized FIUSD legal issuer or establish a contractual redemption obligation; apparent applicability is based on the announced product design, not an operating PPSI.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. Fiserv announced a fully reserved dollar payment-stablecoin design and its 2025 Form 10-K expressly states intent to provide GENIUS-related reserve custody for FIUSD issuance. Retain issuer-announced-intent as a product/infrastructure intent statement, not a PPSI application or issuer authorization. No finalized FIUSD legal issuer was identified, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile were removed and foreignExceptionStatus changed to unknown. The prior statement that all participating banks are actual PPSI issuers via IDI subsidiaries was unsupported. October 1, 2026 platform launch identifies Roughrider Coin as the first live use case and VersaBank as its issuer; that evidence does not establish FIUSD launch, FIUSD issuer identity or any FIUSD GENIUS approval. The product page promises fully reserved USD 1 value, but no actual FIUSD reserve holdings report, accountant attestation or legal redemption policy was located, so disclosure/policy booleans are false. June news reports about an anticipated July launch are historical projections, not confirmed current launch facts. No exact FIUSD GENIUS approval, official application, foreign registration or GENIUS enforcement action was located in the bounded review. October 5 reporting quotes Fiserv embedded-finance leadership continuing to pursue FIUSD without a disclosed launch date, while moving away from the original Paxos/Circle partnership plan. This corroborates ongoing product intent and distinct Roughrider production activity but does not identify a finalized FIUSD legal issuer.
